issue_context.title: Failing Test [sig-network] NoSNAT [Feature:NoSNAT] [Slow] Should be able to send traffic between Pods without SNAT
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:

The test currently only works on Cloud Providers or environments that set the External IP on nodes, because it is using the framework directly to check the IPs of the pods, using a no-snat-test-proxy to check if the Pods are not using SNAT.

However, this can be simplified, removing the no-snat-test-proxy Pod and executing the queries directly in a Pod.

**Why is this needed**:

The test should work in all environments, and it's failing

https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/sig-network-kind#sig-network-kind,%20master&include-filter-by-regex=NoSNAT
